capabilities: Show today's meetings in a sidebar
Create pre-filled meeting notes in one click
Append the day's schedule to daily notes
Harvest tasks and questions from meeting notes
extras: Outlook published feeds omit attendees, so attendee fields stay empty with Outlook links (tracked in #34). No telemetry; only network calls are to your calendar URLs. Part of the Plus Plugin Family. Bases overview needs Obsidian 1.9+.

problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar, and the Outlook Meeting Notes plugin needs both apps open with drag-and-drop.
